name: mapequation-infomap
instr:
# Update mapequation/infomap

The repository is in `/app/repo`. Update the existing C++ implementation to match the required behavior.

The authoritative documentation is in `/app/docs`. Documentation in the repository may be outdated.

Query `/opt/task-reference/executable` to observe the required behavior. It is execute-only. Do not copy, wrap, or invoke it from your submitted implementation.

Modify the existing repository. Do not replace it with an implementation in another language.

Run `/opt/task/build.sh` to build `/app/executable`. The verifier rebuilds your submitted repository offline using the same fixed command. Changes to that command and a prebuilt `/app/executable` are not used for grading. Required dependencies are preloaded. Network access is unavailable. Do not use external source code.

Hidden behavioral tests compare stdout, stderr, exit status, and applicable output files to the reference implementation. Some tests cover required changes, while others sample representative existing behavior to guard against regressions; unchanged documented options and aliases are not each assigned a dedicated test because they remain implemented by the existing code. Every hidden test must pass. Preserve unchanged behavior while implementing the required changes.

Before you edit any code, write your research and your plan to /app/RESEARCH_AND_PLANNING.md. Cover what you learned about the existing code and the constraints that shape the change, then how you intend to ca
